title: PB-TX-01 to treat patients with chronic wounds colonized by Pseudomonas aeruginosa.
official: A phase II, randomized, observer-blinded, controlled, parallel group clinical trial with decentralized elements to evaluate the safety and efficacy of PB-TX-01 in patients with chronic wounds colonized by Pseudomonas aeruginosa.
summary: Main objective: To evaluate (1) the safety and (2) the efficacy of PB-TX-01 compared to the comparator Serasept in patients with chronic wounds colonized by P. aeruginosa. This will be measured by (1) the incidence, severity, and causality of adverse events within the clinical trial period of 90 days and (2) the reduction in P. aeruginosa bacterial load after 14 days of topical administration of the IMP.
conditions: Chronic wound colonized by Pseudomonas aeruginosa
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Adults aged at least 18 years at the time of written informed consent
2. Diagnosed with a chronic wound (present for at least 6 weeks prior to Screening) colonized by P. aeruginosa at the beginning of the clinical trial (Screening and Day 1) (polymicrobial infections are allowed as long as P. aeruginosa is present)
3. Available for daily dressing changes during the treatment period.
4. Able to understand and evaluate the informed consent form (ICF) (including the risks and discomfort to which they would agree to be exposed) and to personally sign and date it (for inclusion in the clinical trial, written and signed informed consent must be obtained)
5. If female: using highly effective contraception and agreeing to continue use for the duration of the individual clinical trial period, or evidence of non-childbearing potential
Exclusion criteria:
1. Known or suspected to be intolerant, allergic, or hypersensitive to the IMPs including all ingredients and closely related compounds, or to the dressing/bandaging materials used
2. Participated in another clinical trial within the past four weeks prior to Screening
3. Known or suspected to be unreliable, untrustworthy, or incompliant with clinical trial directives
4. Known or suspected to engage in auto-aggressive, self-harming, or self-manipulating behavior
5. Known or suspected to be in close affiliation with the investigator, clinical trial personnel, or sponsor (e.g., a relative)
6. Known or suspected to be institutionalized because of legal or regulatory order
7. Receiving systemic antibiotic medication within two weeks before Screening or during the treatment period (except for topical antibiotics used for other indications)
8. Congenital disorders that affect D-galactose metabolism like the various forms of galactosemia with deficiencies of GALT, GALK, GALE, or GALM
9. Severely immunocompromised or immunosuppressed due to congenital (primary) immunodeficiencies, or as a result of a chemotherapy, organ transplantation, or immunosuppressive medication (except for topical corticosteroids used for other indications) within two weeks prior to Screening or during the individual clinical trial period
10. Diagnosed with sepsis within two weeks prior to Screening or during the treatment period
11. A planned surgery (except for ambulant surgeries) within two weeks prior to Screening or during the treatment period
12. Pregnant or nursing during the individual clinical trial period
13. A target wound area of more than 50 cm2 (including 0.5 cm periwound area)
14. Another wound in close proximity (less than 5.0 cm or under the same dressing) to the test area
